charter.goal: Move Habitat from a live semantic workspace toward a resident, provenance-bound agent project environment without replacing canonical source files.
protected_invariants: resident state stores provenance not source bodies
project code is not executed during indexing
generic shell absent from normal agent protocol
weak evidence is not silently upgraded

belief_updates.initial_belief: File/compiler reuse plus graph set-diff is sufficient semantic incrementality.
belief_updates.rival: Relation resolution itself can still repeat broad work after local edits.
belief_updates.probe: Track per-source relation partitions under no-op, body-only edit and candidate-surface expansion.
belief_updates.observation: AGI stress warm has 78 partitions with 0 recomputed; documentation and body-only code probes each recompile one file but recompute 0 base relation partitions. A duplicate-candidate regression forces affected reverse partition invalidation.

belief_updates.initial_belief: A task context packet is enough continuity for an agent.
belief_updates.rival: Repeated turns still rediscover useful objects unless a persistent working set exists.
belief_updates.probe: Admit task context, edit source, switch to related/unrelated tasks, inspect freshness/ranking/materialization.
belief_updates.observation: Fresh relevant residents can receive a bounded resident lane; stale residents are excluded from exact-source materialization; unrelated billing task does not inherit auth residency in regression/benchmark.
belief_updates.change: Persistent Context Residency storing references/provenance/relevance/pin/access state without source bodies.
belief_updates.verifier: residency stale/materialize/task-prior tests + alpha4 demo/trace benchmark

belief_updates.initial_belief: Eviction can always satisfy configured residency capacity.
belief_updates.rival: Pinned residents can legitimately make the bound unsatisfiable.
belief_updates.probe: Pin more residents than max_objects permits, then tighten capacity.
belief_updates.observation: Pinned residents remain and capacity receipt reports overcommitted with explicit reason.
belief_updates.change: Fail visibly on pinned overcommit; never silently evict a pin.

belief_updates.initial_belief: Checkpoint notes plus revision are enough to resume.
belief_updates.rival: Provider identity and resident evidence can drift independently of narrative task text.
belief_updates.probe: Resume unchanged, after unrelated edit, and after resident-source edit.
belief_updates.observation: Modes classify direct → selective-revalidate → reorient; checkpoint binds compiler/provider fingerprint and event cursor.
belief_updates.change: Provenance-bound checkpoint/resume state and explicit continuation classes.

belief_updates.initial_belief: Component/render ownership is sufficient UI-to-source evidence.
belief_updates.rival: Agent often needs the actual handler implementing an interaction.
belief_updates.probe: Parse TSX onClick identifier, resolve semantic handler, correlate runtime unique anchor.
belief_updates.observation: Supported fixture exposes framework-event-handler:click to handleSave at parser trust.
belief_updates.change: handles_event relation and runtime handler source hints; ambiguity still downgrades trust.

belief_updates.initial_belief: Protocol plumbing can be benchmarked from ad-hoc counters.
belief_updates.rival: Without first-class transparent instrumentation, numbers may be inconsistent or perturb operations.
belief_updates.probe: Trace orient/materialize calls and force recorder failure.
belief_updates.observation: Trace reports calls/request/response/exact-source bytes; forced telemetry failure leaves query result successful.
belief_updates.change: Persistent trace sessions; trace controls excluded; telemetry non-authoritative.

belief_updates.initial_belief: Implementation-class structural bonus is useful even with no task concept match.
belief_updates.rival: It fills context budget with unrelated helper functions.
belief_updates.observation: Initial trace included billing/noise symbols; after requiring at least one content match, credential tasks select only auth.py and billing task only billing.py.
belief_updates.change: Task-class/trust bonuses apply only after content evidence exists.

negative_results_preserved.failure: Legacy alpha.3 regression expected any Python edit to miss the base semantic cache.
negative_results_preserved.correction: Updated the contract only after relation-partition correctness proved body-only reuse is legitimate.

negative_results_preserved.failure: Draft residency test assumed orientation selected exactly one object.
negative_results_preserved.correction: Verify source-free storage invariant rather than incidental selection cardinality.

negative_results_preserved.failure: Draft source-free assertion confused source_digest/source_bytes_estimate provenance with copied source body.
negative_results_preserved.correction: Check absence of exact source payload, while allowing provenance fields.

negative_results_preserved.failure: Relation partition fingerprint initially included source digest and dirtied body-only edits.
negative_results_preserved.correction: Removed digest from relation partition identity; provider/compiler version remains a separate invalidation boundary.

negative_results_preserved.failure: First alpha.4 trace benchmark materialized unrelated noise symbols because implementation structural bonus applied without content match.
negative_results_preserved.correction: Require at least one strong content match before structural/trust promotion; add regression and regenerate report.

negative_results_preserved.failure: RC package smoke in a stdlib venv could not import setuptools.build_meta because that venv did not inherit the host /opt/pyvenv site-packages.
negative_results_preserved.correction: Do not weaken pyproject metadata. Verify with the host setuptools 82.0.1 backend using --no-build-isolation --no-deps --target, then isolated-mode import from that target.

admission_evidence.tests: 88/88 PASS in source tree before packaging

claim_boundary: Admit bounded semantic-partition/residency/checkpoint/UI-handler/instrumentation mechanisms only. No token reduction, coding-success uplift, fully incremental TypeScript semantics, hostile-code sandbox, framework-complete provenance, AGI claim.
